## Onboard Vendor (OV)

The single writer for the profile → vendor transition: validates the profile is `approved`, compliance-current, and not already onboarded; creates the active `Vendor` (reusing the existing card as-is); links it back; stamps the profile `onboarded`. Enforces the same gate the comparison board displays — an award-ineligible vendor never enters the invitable pool.

### Example

Natural target: the linked Norvik Ltd profile — currently REFUSED by this command (lapsed ISO 9001), which is the gate working as designed; Acme Supply's profile shows the successful outcome.

### Non-goals

No welcome emails or credential provisioning (no vendor persona exists). No re-onboarding — an onboarded profile is terminal.
